title: fix(app-shell): on a phone, a list authored to open nothing opens nothing
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAoNwrZVJoUEFfvMURpRPKJ)_
Fixes #33719
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 手机上打开一个设为「不打开记录」的列表时，点卡片不再进入记录页，卡片也不再显示为可点；分享来的带记录参数的链接同样不打开，和桌面一致。
- 落实你在该卡上裁定的 A：作者声明的「不打开」在手机上也算数，属于 Console 手机端体验收口。
- 只影响本来就声明了「不打开」的列表；出错表现为这类列表在手机上又能点开或其他列表点不开，可直接撤回本改动。
- 无

## What changes

Ruling A on #33719 (triage comment 6897459964, maintainer 「都同意」): on a phone, an authored `navigation.mode: 'none'` and `navigation.preventNavigation: true` hold, as on a desktop.

- `detailNavigation` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` now reads the authored navigation once and returns `none` for `preventNavigation` or `mode === 'none'` **before** the phone rule (#27058), which still answers `page` for every list that does open. The tap handler and the card's tappable face both read the resolved mode (`rowOpensRecord`, #33548), so the one move carries both.
- Scope item 2, the `?recordId=` deep link: on a desktop a `none` list's link draws no pane (`NavigationOverlay` shows a record only in `drawer` mode). The phone branch of the URL-sync effect navigated to the record page regardless of the mode; it now returns when the resolved mode is `none`, so a phone opens no page either. The URL is left as it is, as on a desktop.
- Scope item 3: one docs sentence in `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` (How a list opens a record): on a phone the columns a card does not show are unreachable on such a list, so declare `none` / `preventNavigation` only where the rows need no detail view.
- File header of `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` updated to say the phone rule decides how a record opens, never whether (consistent with the #35854 header text already there).
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Tests

New pin `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.phoneNavigationNone-33719.test.tsx`, driven at 375 px through the real `ObjectView`, `ListView`, grid and `MePermissionsProvider`:

- for each of `mode: 'none'` and `preventNavigation: true`: the phone card draws no pointer / hover wash and a tap opens nothing (no `/record/`, no `window.open`);
- for each spelling: a `?recordId=c1` link leaves the console on the list URL and draws no drawer;
- CONTROL: a list with no authored navigation keeps its pointer, and both its tap and its `?recordId=` link open the record page.

<details><summary>Readings (head 6b4f34b9)</summary>

- New pin + neighbours (`ObjectView.cardFacesOpenNothing-33548`, `ObjectView.phoneRecordPage-27058`, `objectViewRecordNavigation.phonePush-29074`, `objectViewRecordNavigation.listRows-27524`): Test Files 5 passed (5), Tests 44 passed (44); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation, whole fix reverted to base (`git restore --source=73d5e347`): Tests 4 failed, 2 passed (6) — all four `none` / `preventNavigation` pins red, both CONTROLs green.
- Ablation, only the deep-link guard removed: Tests 2 failed, 4 passed (6) — exactly the two `?recordId=` pins red.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`, which compiles the new test): exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- AGENTS.md asks a new pin for a component with a shared harness file to go into that file. `ObjectView` has no shared harness file (only per-card files), and the dispatch named one new file for this card, so the pin carries its own copy of the 33548 file's mount harness (grid face only).
- The `?recordId=` link on a `none` list keeps its `?recordId=` in the URL on both viewports; nothing reads it there. Not changed (desktop behaviour is the reference per the ruling).

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` — the `detailNavigation` reorder, and the `detailNavigation.mode === 'none'` guard in the phone branch of the URL-sync effect.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.phoneNavigationNone-33719.test.tsx`.
3. `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.phoneNavigationNone-33719.test.tsx` — expect 6 passed.
